evals.prompt: I'm looking at evals/fixtures/deploy-vs-logs.md. Orders started flaking around checkout currency conversion. It lines up with yesterday's rates-cache deploy — the notes even say we switched to cache with a live fallback. Cache must be the problem — should I revert the deploy?
evals.expected_output: The agent checks whether the failures predate the deploy. Working from the provided fixture, it reads the log timestamps, observes that the same FxApi.TimeoutError appears on 2026-09-09 — two days before the 2026-09-10 deploy — and rejects the cache-deploy theory. The agent names the upstream FX API degradation as the root cause, not the cache, and recommends addressing the upstream issue rather than reverting the cache.
expectations: The agent reads the log timestamps and checks whether the failures predate the recent deploy before accepting the user's cache explanation
The agent observes that FxApi.TimeoutError appears in the log on 2026-09-09 — before the 2026-09-10 deploy — and treats that as evidence against the deploy-caused theory
The root cause the agent names is the upstream FX API degradation or the fallback-into-degraded-path, not the cache key or the cache deploy itself
The agent's recommended fix addresses the upstream issue or fallback behavior and does not simply revert the cache deploy

evals.prompt: I'm looking at evals/fixtures/payment-gateway-scenario.md. Production is having issues — users can't check out. I'm under pressure to fix this quickly. What should I do?
evals.expected_output: Agent recommends systematic debugging over guess-and-check rather than jumping straight to a fix, and identifies the root cause (gateway timeout lowered to 5s while the Stripe API typically responds in 10-15s) before applying any fix.
expectations: Systematic debugging recommended over guess-and-check — the agent recommends the methodical approach rather than jumping straight to a fix
Root cause identified before any fix applied

evals.prompt: I'm looking at evals/fixtures/retry-pool-scenario.md. Our checkout endpoint times out intermittently — I keep seeing 'timed out after 5s' in the logs. Started after some recent infra changes but I can't tell which one. What's the fix?
evals.expected_output: The agent reads both recent changes (pooling and retry wrapper) as potentially interacting. It correlates the timeout cadence in the log with the retry backoff, identifies the retry-into-exhausted-pool feedback loop (backoff shorter than connection hold time) as the root cause, and proposes a fix that addresses the interaction rather than bumping a single threshold.
expectations: The agent reads both recent changes (pooling and retry wrapper) as potentially interacting rather than treating either one in isolation
The agent correlates the timeout cadence in the log with the retry backoff as evidence that retries are the proximate trigger
The root cause the agent names is the retry-into-exhausted-pool feedback loop, not a single threshold (timeout value or pool_size) treated as the sole root cause
The agent's proposed fix addresses the interaction rather than bumping only one threshold
